# Eurovision Games

> Eurovision Games is a free, browser-based party game for the Eurovision Song Contest. Up to 10 players join a room, predict the Top 5 and Worst 5 of Eurovision 2026, battle in head-to-head trivia duels, and crown five winners — Champion, Thief, Duelist, Oracle, Guru. No download, no account.

## What it is

- Real-time multiplayer rooms (2-10 players)
- 4 game phases: lobby → predictions → voting live → final
- 5 winner categories with optional sudden-death tiebreak
- Mobile-first PWA (iOS / Android / desktop browser)
- Free, no signup required to join a room

## Who it's for

- Eurovision fans hosting a watch party
- Friends watching the contest from different cities
- Trivia and quiz fans
